question: What were Ollie's Bargain Outlet's trailing-twelve-month net sales and net income as of the end of its fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended August 1, 2026), and what was the implied TTM net margin?
grading: Computation: TTM = FY2025 + 26 weeks FY2026 - 26 weeks FY2025. Net sales USD 2,793.1M (2,793,108K); GAAP net income USD 273.6M (273,580K); net margin 9.79% (+/-0.3pp). Accept +/-0.5% on dollar figures. Fail if the TTM window is wrong (not Aug 3, 2025-Aug 1, 2026) or adjusted net income is used.
answer: TTM to August 1, 2026 = FY2025 (52 weeks ended Jan 31, 2026) + 26 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026 - 26 weeks ended Aug 2, 2025. Net sales: 2,649,198 + 1,400,233 - 1,256,323 = USD 2,793,108 thousand (USD 2,793.1 million). Net income: 240,596 + 141,854 - 108,870 = USD 273,580 thousand (USD 273.6 million). TTM net margin = 273,580 / 2,793,108 = 9.79% [H10-E1][H10-E2].

output.answer:
## Ollie's Bargain Outlet (NASDAQ: OLLI) — TTM figures as of fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended Aug 1, 2026)

**Trailing-twelve-month net sales: ~$2.793 billion**
**Trailing-twelve-month net income: ~$273.6 million**
**Implied TTM net margin: ~9.8%**

### How it's derived (TTM = FY2025 + 1H FY2026 − 1H FY2025)

| Period | Net sales | Net income |
|---|---|---|
| FY2025 (year ended Jan 31, 2026) | $2,649.2M | $240.6M |
| Less: 1H FY2025 (26 wks ended Aug 2, 2025) | −$1,256.3M | −$108.9M |
| Plus: 1H FY2026 (26 wks ended Aug 1, 2026) | +$1,400.2M | +$141.9M |
| **TTM** | **$2,793.1M** | **$273.6M** |

- TTM net margin = $273.6M ÷ $2,793.1M = **9.79%**

Component detail:
- Q2 FY2026: net sales $741.3M, net income $85.5M (net margin 11.5%); 1H FY2026 net income = Q1 $56.4M + Q2 $85.5M = $141.9M
- 1H FY2025 net income = $47.6M + $61.3M = $108.9M
- FY2025 was a 52-week year (Ollie's FY2023 was the 53-week year), so no extra-week distortion in this calc

Note this uses **GAAP net income**. On an adjusted basis, TTM net income would be modestly higher (adjusted figures exclude stock-based compensation tax benefits and other items).

Sources:
- Q2 FY2026 results: https://investors.ollies.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ollies-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-second-quarter-8
- Q2 FY2026 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1639300/000110465926104755/olli-20260801x10q.htm
- FY2025 (Q4) results: https://investors.ollies.us/news-releases/news-release-details/ollies-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-fourth-quarter
- Q2 FY2025 results: https://investors.ollies.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ollies-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-second-quarter-6
